R01: Order and cargo items carry every mandatory field (shipment, customer, origin, destination, delivery window, at least one item and one leg, quote).
R02: Each cargo item has a valid weight and dimensions within policy limits (grams and millimetres, integers).
R03: The declared category is consistent with the free-text cargo description (Jev, Noul).
R04: The handling branch of each item is determined: general, cold chain, controlled or mixed. Incomplete branch data keeps it UNKNOWN.
R04-COLD: Condition: the item needs cold chain handling.
R04-CONTROLLED: Condition: the item is controlled goods.
R05: The whole consignment fits every planned vehicle by payload, and each item fits the cargo space.
R06: Planned arrival of the final leg falls inside the customer delivery window.
R07: Legs start at the origin, end at the destination, connect location to location, and leave at least the minimum connection time.
R08: The evaluated revision and entity versions match the stored current versions.
R09: A controlled item has a non-empty safety data sheet and controlled goods declaration.
R10: The controlled documents describe the same goods as the cargo description (Jev, Noul).
R11: Every leg carrier holds a controlled goods qualification valid through the planned arrival.
R12: The mixing matrix allows every combination of categories and controlled classes in the shipment.
R13: A compliance reviewer has signed off this cargo, carrier and route.
R14: Controlled branch ready: R09 to R13 all pass.
R15: A cold chain item has a defined target temperature range.
R16: Every planned vehicle's temperature control covers the item's range.
R17: The temperature sensor is calibrated through departure and its last reading is recent enough at departure.
R18: The inspection note has been assessed for packaging damage or cold chain risk (Jev, Choice). Records the signal as a fact.
R18-RISK: Condition: the inspection found a risk that needs rework.
R19: The temperature log has been checked for excursions. Records the longest continuous excursion as a fact.
R19-EXCURSION: Condition: an excursion exceeded the tolerated duration.
R20: A quality reviewer has decided how to handle the excursion; the decision may require rework.
R20-REWORK: Condition: the quality decision requires rework.
R21-REQUIRED: Condition: rework is required by the inspection risk or by the quality decision.
R21: The warehouse has repacked the item and uploaded evidence.
R22-CAPTURE: The warehouse has captured a retest reading after rework.
R22: The retest reading lies inside the target range.
R23: Cold chain branch ready: range, vehicle, sensor, assessments, and every required disposition, rework and retest.
R24: Each leg carrier serves both ends of the leg.
R25: Each leg vehicle belongs to the leg carrier and has temperature control when any item needs cold chain.
R26: Every transfer hub supports the shipment's categories, including cold chain where needed.
R27: The customer's written restrictions allow the current route and handover (Jev, Noul).
R28: An alternative plan re-runs the plan checks before it can replace the current plan (used during rerouting).
R29: The current plan has an active carrier reservation for its route version.
R30: Transport plan valid: capacity, timing, connections, per-leg checks, customer restrictions and reservation.
R32: The quote fits in the customer's remaining credit.
R33: Applies only over credit: the excess is within the approvable exception limit.
R34: Applies only over credit: a commercial manager has approved the exception for this customer and quote.
R35-REQUIRED: Condition: a reroute raised the cost above the approval threshold.
R35: A commercial manager has approved the extra cost.
R36: Commercial branch ready: R31 AND (R32 OR (R33 AND R34)) AND R35 where required.
R37: Every cargo item passes its base checks and every applicable branch; a controlled cold chain item needs both.
R38: Every applicable pre-load human gate is complete: compliance sign-off, quality disposition, repack, retest capture, credit and extra cost approvals.
R39-LOAD: The warehouse has scanned and physically checked the load.
R39: Loading and dispatcher confirmation are complete.
R40: The order may dispatch. Re-evaluated inside the dispatch transaction.
